dslRule:
<!id: add-deprecated-to-create-standard-groups>
<!description: Adds the @Deprecated annotation to the createStandardGroups method to mark it as deprecated.
It addresses situations where an API should be discouraged without breaking existing code directly.>
<!severity: WARNING>
public static void $name($params$) :: methodNameMatches($name, "createStandardGroups")
=> @java.lang.Deprecated public static void $name($params$)
;;
summary: Adds the @Deprecated annotation to the `createStandardGroups` method.
